name: Updating a permission set sends a 'Permission Set Updated' email
description:
Objective: Updating a permission set sends a 'Permission Set Updated' email.
Preconditions: Open Permission set emails with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Permission set emails.
2. Updating a permission set sends a 'Permission Set Updated' email.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: Editing / updating a permission set must trigger PERMISSION_SET_UPDATED email delivered to users holding that permission set in the configured app.

statusMessage:

- RUN_EXTERNAL_DELIVERY_TESTS is not true; release E2E requires an explicit approval before sending real email.
statusTrace:

    assert_external_delivery_ready()
tests/support/external_delivery_guard.py:79: in assert_external_delivery_ready
    raise AssertionError("External-delivery release gate failed:\n- " + "\n- ".join(problems))
